description: INDEX:80 Ecosystem Signals: material, recorded changes to the state of the Cardano ecosystem. Not a news feed: a signal records something that changed (a standard deployed, infrastructure live, adoption deployed, a governance or funding decision, a major project launch, closure, acquisition or failure), or a material governance decision that is open now and expires when it closes. Never price, rumour, commentary, routine updates or partnership PR. Signals stay in this registry permanently; expires_at only ends their time in WHAT'S CURRENT (default: 30 days after the signal date, or earlier at a natural deadline such as a vote).

signals.headline: CIP-0113 programmable tokens live on Cardano mainnet
signals.summary: Programmable transfer rules for Cardano-native assets are now live, enabling issuer-defined compliance logic for use cases such as regulated stablecoins, tokenised funds and other regulated assets.
signals.why_it_matters: This materially expands the kinds of regulated assets and compliance-aware applications that can be built while remaining native to Cardano.

signals.headline: Three Cardano governance actions are open for voting
signals.summary: Open for voting: an 11,787,063 ada treasury withdrawal for the OpenZeppelin Stack and a proposal to reduce minPoolCost to 75 ada (both expire 11 Oct), plus an info action asking whether stakePoolTargetNum (k) should rise from 500 to 1000 (expires 21 Oct).
signals.why_it_matters: Treasury spending and the stake pool parameters that shape pool economics and decentralisation are being decided on-chain now; each outcome changes how Cardano funds work or rewards stake pools.

signals.headline: Cardano treasury budgets move into live USDM smart contracts
signals.summary: Intersect's 2026/27 budget and Se7en Labs' treasury withdrawal have been minted through Moneta into USDM, the Cardano-native USD stablecoin, and the smart contracts holding the funds are live on-chain.
signals.why_it_matters: Holding community-approved treasury funds in a Cardano-native stablecoin lets the approved work be paid on the fixed terms it was agreed on, independent of ada price movement.

signals.headline: Petrobras delivers renewable-fuel traceability apps on Cardano
signals.summary: Petrobras and the Cardano Foundation have delivered two R&D applications that use Cardano to trace sustainable aviation fuel certificates and renewable diesel (Diesel R) lifecycle data.
signals.why_it_matters: A state-controlled energy major using a public blockchain to make sustainability claims verifiable is a substantive enterprise use case, although both applications are at the R&D stage.

signals.headline: Cardano joins x402 for AI-agent payments in ADA
signals.summary: Cardano is now a supported network in the official x402 SDK: the @x402/cardano package lets apps and AI agents pay for HTTP API calls in ADA or Cardano native assets, with Developer Portal templates and a Foundation-hosted facilitator.
signals.why_it_matters: Native support in an open, cross-chain payment standard lets x402-based services and AI agents add Cardano payments with standard tooling instead of a bespoke integration.

signals.headline: Plutus development moves to Midgard Labs
signals.summary: Plutus, the platform Cardano developers use to write and run smart contracts, moves from IO Labs to Midgard Labs, with the team moving from 1 October and both labs collaborating through the transition.
signals.why_it_matters: Core smart-contract infrastructure passes to an independent specialist team, continuing the move of Cardano's core engineering away from a single company.
